```{r}
# File: src/r/functions_shiny.R
# Purpose: Explore symptom profiles, diagnosis labels, and DSM references.
#
# The symptom circles are currently a UI prototype. Toggling them does not
# yet recalculate diagnosis labels; that behaviour will be added later.
# DSM checklist text is reference-only and does not change the rules.
# Sourcing this file defines the function but does not launch the app.

create_shiny_app <- function(dataset, key, dsm_checklists = NULL) {

  if (!requireNamespace("shiny", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("Install Shiny first: install.packages('shiny').")
  }

  if (!is.data.frame(dataset) || nrow(dataset) == 0L) {
    stop("dataset must be a nonempty data frame.")
  }

  if (!is.data.frame(key) ||
      !all(c("name", "disorder", "criterion") %in% names(key))) {
    stop("key must be a data frame with name, disorder, and criterion columns.")
  }

  if (!exists("apply_dsm_rules", mode = "function") ||
      !exists("default_thresholds")) {
    stop("Source src/r/functions_dsm_rules.R before creating the app.")
  }

  disorders <- c("bipolar", "depression", "anxiety", "schizophrenia", "ptsd")
  disorder_labels <- c(
    "Bipolar", "Depression", "Anxiety", "Schizophrenia", "PTSD"
  )
  diagnosis_columns <- paste0("dx_", disorders)
  rule_columns <- paste0("rule_", disorders)

  # Prepare symptom variables from the variable key.
symptom_key <- key[
  !duplicated(as.character(key$name)),
  c("name", "original", "disorder", "criterion"),
  drop = FALSE
]

  symptom_key$name <- as.character(symptom_key$name)
  symptom_key$disorder <- tolower(as.character(symptom_key$disorder))
  symptom_key$criterion <- as.character(symptom_key$criterion)

  symptom_key <- symptom_key[
    symptom_key$disorder %in% disorders,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  # Convert variable names such as "sleep_change" to readable labels.
  symptom_label <- function(x) {
    x <- gsub("_+", " ", x)
    x <- gsub("\\.", " ", x)
    tools::toTitleCase(trimws(x))
  }

  # Check that the symptom and original diagnosis columns exist.
  required_columns <- unique(c(as.character(key$name), diagnosis_columns))
  missing_columns <- setdiff(required_columns, names(dataset))

  if (length(missing_columns) > 0L) {
    stop(
      "Missing dataset columns: ",
      paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  # Symptoms and original diagnosis columns must contain 0, 1, or NA.
  is_binary <- function(values) {
    (is.numeric(values) || is.logical(values)) &&
      all(is.na(values) | values %in% c(0, 1))
  }

  valid_binary <- vapply(
    dataset[, required_columns, drop = FALSE],
    is_binary,
    logical(1)
  )

  if (!all(valid_binary)) {
    stop(
      "Expected numeric/logical 0/1 values in: ",
      paste(names(valid_binary)[!valid_binary], collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  # Rebuild diagnosis labels using the project's default DSM-style rules.
  app_data <- apply_dsm_rules(
    dataset,
    key,
    thresholds = default_thresholds
  )

  if (!all(rule_columns %in% names(app_data))) {
    stop("apply_dsm_rules() did not return all five rule_* columns.")
  }

  valid_rules <- vapply(
    app_data[, rule_columns, drop = FALSE],
    is_binary,
    logical(1)
  )

  if (!all(valid_rules)) {
    stop("Expected numeric/logical 0/1 values in rebuilt diagnosis columns.")
  }

  
  # Prepare optional DSM checklist reference material.
  # Each disorder entry can contain:
  # edition, source_title, source_url, and criteria.

  if (is.null(dsm_checklists)) {
    dsm_checklists <- list()
  }

  if (!is.list(dsm_checklists)) {
    stop("dsm_checklists must be a named list.")
  }

  if (length(dsm_checklists) > 0L) {
    checklist_names <- names(dsm_checklists)

    if (is.null(checklist_names) ||
        anyNA(checklist_names) ||
        any(!nzchar(checklist_names)) ||
        anyDuplicated(checklist_names)) {
      stop("Every checklist entry must have a unique disorder name.")
    }

    invalid_names <- setdiff(checklist_names, disorders)

    if (length(invalid_names)) {
      stop(
        "Unknown checklist names: ",
        paste(invalid_names, collapse = ", ")
      )
    }
  }

  # Read a single optional text field from a checklist entry.
  read_text <- function(entry, field, disorder) {
    value <- entry[[field]]

    if (is.null(value)) {
      return("")
    }

    if (!is.character(value) || length(value) != 1L || is.na(value)) {
      stop(disorder, "$", field, " must be a single non-missing string.")
    }

    trimws(value)
  }

  # Ensure every disorder has a checklist entry, even if it is empty.
  checklists <- stats::setNames(
    lapply(disorders, function(disorder) {

      entry <- dsm_checklists[[disorder]]

      if (is.null(entry)) {
        entry <- list()
      }

      if (!is.list(entry)) {
        stop("Checklist for ", disorder, " must be a list.")
      }

      edition <- read_text(entry, "edition", disorder)
      source_title <- read_text(entry, "source_title", disorder)
      source_url <- read_text(entry, "source_url", disorder)

      if (nzchar(source_url) &&
          !grepl(
            "^https?://[^[:space:]]+$",
            source_url,
            ignore.case = TRUE
          )) {
        stop(
          "Source URL for ", disorder,
          " must start with http:// or https://."
        )
      }

      criteria <- entry$criteria

      if (is.null(criteria)) {
        criteria <- character(0)
      }

      if (!is.character(criteria) || anyNA(criteria)) {
        stop(
          "Criteria for ", disorder,
          " must be a character vector without NA."
        )
      }

      criteria <- criteria[nzchar(trimws(criteria))]

      list(
        edition = edition,
        source_title = source_title,
        source_url = source_url,
        criteria = criteria
      )
    }),
    disorders
  )

  # Create one expandable reference section for each disorder.
  checklist_section <- function(disorder, label) {

    entry <- checklists[[disorder]]

    shiny::tags$details(
      class = "dsm-section",
      shiny::tags$summary(label),

      shiny::tags$div(
        class = "dsm-content",

        shiny::tags$h4("DSM checklist"),

        shiny::tags$p(
          class = "reference-meta",
          if (nzchar(entry$edition)) {
            paste("Edition:", entry$edition)
          } else {
            "DSM edition not supplied."
          }
        ),

        if (nzchar(entry$source_title)) {
          shiny::tags$p(
            class = "reference-meta",
            paste("Source:", entry$source_title)
          )
        },

        if (nzchar(entry$source_url)) {
          shiny::tags$p(
            shiny::tags$a(
              href = entry$source_url,
              target = "_blank",
              rel = "noopener noreferrer",
              "Read source"
            )
          )
        },

        if (length(entry$criteria)) {
          shiny::tags$ol(
            lapply(entry$criteria, function(item) {
              shiny::tags$li(item)
            })
          )
        } else {
          shiny::tags$p(
            class = "empty-checklist",
            "No criteria supplied yet. Add your sourced checklist text ",
            "to the dsm_checklists list passed into create_shiny_app()."
          )
        }
      )
    )
  }

  # Build the user interface and its styling.
  ui <- shiny::fluidPage(

    shiny::tags$head(
      shiny::tags$style(
        shiny::HTML("
          body {
            background: #f7f5f0;
            color: #24364b;
          }

          .container-fluid {
            max-width: 1400px;
            padding: 24px;
          }

          .well {
            background: #fff;
            border: 1px solid #dce3ec;
            border-radius: 12px;
            box-shadow: none;
          }

          h1, h2, h3, h4 {
            color: #172b4d;
          }

          .diagnosis-table {
            width: 100%;
            margin: 16px 0;
            border-collapse: collapse;
            background: #fff;
            border-radius: 10px;
            overflow: hidden;
          }

          .diagnosis-table th,
          .diagnosis-table td {
            padding: 12px 16px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid #dde3eb;
            text-align: left;
          }

          .diagnosis-table th {
            background: #edf1f6;
          }

          .diagnosis-table tbody tr:nth-child(even) {
            background: #fafbfd;
          }

          .diagnosis-status {
            display: inline-block;
            padding: 5px 10px;
            border-radius: 999px;
            font-weight: 600;
          }

          .diagnosis-present {
color:#1855a3;
  background-color:#edf4ff;
  border:1px solid #bfd5f4;
}

.diagnosis-absent {
color:#aa182c;
  background-color:#fff0f2;
  border:1px solid #edbec7;
}

.diagnosis-unknown {
color:#505967;
  background-color:#eff1f4;
  border:1px solid #d3d8df;
}

          .symptom-disorder {
            margin: 18px 0 8px;
          }

          .symptom-criterion {
            color: #596575;
            font-size: 13px;
            margin: 12px 0 8px;
          }

          .symptom-grid {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 10px;
}

.symptom-card {
  min-height: auto;
  padding: 12px 16px;
  justify-content: flex-start;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.symptom-card .checkbox {
  width: 100%;
  margin: 0;
  text-align: left;
}

.symptom-card .checkbox label {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: row;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: flex-start;
  gap: 14px;
  padding-left: 0;
  width: 100%;
  text-align: left;
  white-space: normal;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}

.symptom-card input[type='checkbox'] {
  position: relative;
  margin: 0;
  width: 34px;
  height: 34px;
  flex: 0 0 34px;
}

.symptom-card input[type='checkbox']:checked::after {
  font-size: 20px;
}

.symptom-note {
  width: 100%;
  text-align: left;
  margin-top: 6px;
}

          .symptom-note {
            color: #64748b;
            font-size: 12px;
            text-align: center;
          }

          .dsm-section {
            border: 1px solid #dce3ec;
            border-radius: 9px;
            margin: 10px 0;
            background: #fff;
          }

          .dsm-section summary {
            cursor: pointer;
            padding: 14px;
            font-weight: 600;
          }

          .dsm-section summary:focus-visible {
            outline: 3px solid #8cb7ed;
          }

          .dsm-section[open] summary {
            border-bottom: 1px solid #dce3ec;
          }

          .dsm-content {
            padding: 4px 18px 16px;
          }

          .dsm-content li {
            margin: 9px 0;
            line-height: 1.6;
            white-space: pre-wrap;
          }

          .reference-meta {
            color: #596575;
            font-size: 13px;
          }

          .empty-checklist {
            padding: 12px;
            background: #f5f7fa;
            color: #596575;
          }
          .reference-panel {
            padding: 18px;
            margin-top: 18px;
            background: #fff;
            border: 1px solid #dce3ec;
            border-radius: 12px;
          }

          .modal-dialog.modal-lg {
            width: 96vw;
            max-width: 1400px;
          }

          .expanded-reference {
            max-height: 75vh;
            overflow-y: auto;
          }
          .diagnosis-table .diagnosis-status.diagnosis-present {
color:#1855a3;
  background-color:#edf4ff;
  border:1px solid #bfd5f4;
}

.diagnosis-table .diagnosis-status.diagnosis-absent {
color:#aa182c;
  background-color:#fff0f2;
  border:1px solid #edbec7;
}

.diagnosis-table .diagnosis-status.diagnosis-unknown {
color:#505967;
  background-color:#eff1f4;
  border:1px solid #d3d8df;
}
        ")
      )
    ),

    shiny::titlePanel(title = "Psychiatric Symptom Profile & Diagnostic Tool Simulation App", windowTitle = "Symptom Explorer"), shiny::tags$p("Welcome! Explore DSM V criteria for Bipolar Disorder, Depression, Anxiety, and PTSD, individual symptom profiles, and simulate alternative diagnostic scenarios. This app is intended as a visual teaching tool for understanding the DSM V diagnostic structure.",
                                                                                                                                               class = "app-subtitle"), 
shiny::tags$section(
  class = "reference-panel",
  shiny::h3("DSM textbook reference"),
  shiny::p(
    "Review the sourced criteria for each disorder. ",
    "Select a disorder to expand its checklist."
  ),
  shiny::actionButton("expand_reference", "Open expanded reference view"),
  shiny::tagList(lapply(seq_along(disorders), function(i) {
    checklist_section(disorders[i], disorder_labels[i])
  }))
), shiny::hr(), 

    shiny::sidebarLayout(

      shiny::sidebarPanel(
        shiny::selectizeInput(
          "participant",
          "Select an example profile",
          choices = as.character(seq_len(nrow(app_data))),
          selected = "1"
        ), 
        
        shiny::hr(),

        shiny::h4("Diagnosis"),

        shiny::textOutput("selected_row"),

        shiny::uiOutput("diagnosis_table"),

        shiny::hr(),

        shiny::helpText(
          "Symptom controls are a visual prototype. Toggling them does not save ",
          "changes or recalculate diagnosis labels."
        )
      ), shiny::mainPanel(

        shiny::h3("Symptom profile"),

        shiny::p(
          "Symptoms are grouped using the current variable key. The circles ",
          "show the selected row's recorded values. Changes do not yet ",
          "recalculate diagnosis labels."
        ),

        shiny::uiOutput("symptom_map"),


        shiny::hr(),

        shiny::h4("Interpretation"),

        shiny::p(
           "Present (blue) means 1; absent (red) means 0. ",
  "Missing labels are shown as unknown (grey), not absent."
        ),

        shiny::p(
          "Educational use only. Displayed labels are calculated using the ", "dataset's implemented DSM-style rules, which may differ from full ", "DSM criteria. The DSM reference is provided separately for comparison; ", "these labels are not clinical diagnoses."
        ),

        shiny::p(
          "This educational app is not a diagnostic tool. Supply only reference ",
          "text you have permission to reproduce, and include its edition and source."
        )
      )
    )
  )

  # Define how the app responds to the selected dataset row.
  server <- function(input, output, session) {
    
    shiny::observeEvent(input$expand_reference, {
  shiny::showModal(
    shiny::modalDialog(
      title = "DSM textbook reference",
      size = "l",
      easyClose = TRUE,
      footer = shiny::modalButton("Close"),
      shiny::tags$div(
        class = "expanded-reference",
        shiny::tagList(
          lapply(seq_along(disorders), function(i) {
            checklist_section(disorders[i], disorder_labels[i])
          })
        )
      )
    )
  )
})

    # Retrieve the selected row from the rebuilt dataset.
    original_profile <- shiny::reactive({

      shiny::req(input$participant)

      row_number <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(input$participant))

      shiny::validate(
        shiny::need(
          length(row_number) == 1L &&
            !is.na(row_number) &&
            row_number >= 1L &&
            row_number <= nrow(app_data),
          "Select a valid dataset row."
        )
      )

      app_data[row_number, , drop = FALSE]
    })

    # Draw symptom circles grouped by disorder and criterion.
    # Each symptom has a unique input ID based on its key-row position.
    # Missing values are disabled rather than treated as absent.
    output$symptom_map <- shiny::renderUI({

      profile <- original_profile()

      if (nrow(symptom_key) == 0L) {
        return(
          shiny::p(
            "No symptom variables could be grouped from variable_key.",
            class = "empty-checklist"
          )
        )
      }

      symptom_sections <- lapply(disorders, function(disorder) {

        disorder_rows <- which(symptom_key$disorder == disorder)

        if (length(disorder_rows) == 0L) {
          return(NULL)
        }

        # Group symptoms by criterion, preserving their key order.
        criteria <- unique(symptom_key$criterion[disorder_rows])

        criterion_sections <- lapply(criteria, function(criterion) {

          rows <- disorder_rows[
            symptom_key$criterion[disorder_rows] == criterion
          ]

          symptom_cards <- lapply(rows, function(i) {

            column_name <- symptom_key$name[i]
            value <- profile[[column_name]][1]
            missing_value <- is.na(value)
            input_id <- paste0("symptom_toggle_", i)

            shiny::tags$div(
              class = "symptom-card",

              shiny::checkboxInput(
                inputId = input_id,
                label = as.character(symptom_key$original[i]),
                value = !missing_value && as.numeric(value) == 1,
                width = "100%"
              ),

              if (missing_value) {
                shiny::tags$div(
                  "Missing value",
                  class = "symptom-note"
                )
              }
            )
          })

          shiny::tagList(

            shiny::tags$h4(
              if (is.na(criterion) || !nzchar(criterion)) {
                "Symptoms"
              } else {
                paste("Criterion", criterion)
              },
              class = "symptom-criterion"
            ),

            shiny::tags$div(
              class = "symptom-grid",
              symptom_cards
            )
          )
        })

        shiny::tagList(

          shiny::tags$h3(
            disorder_labels[match(disorder, disorders)],
            class = "symptom-disorder"
          ),

          criterion_sections
        )
      })

      shiny::tagList(symptom_sections)
    })

    # Display which row is currently selected.
    output$selected_row <- shiny::renderText({
      original_profile()
      paste("Selected example profile:", input$participant)
    })

    # Show the rebuilt diagnosis labels with styled status indicators.
    output$diagnosis_table <- shiny::renderUI({

      profile <- original_profile()

      values <- as.numeric(
        unlist(
          profile[, rule_columns, drop = FALSE],
          use.names = FALSE
        )
      )

      shiny::tags$table(
        class = "diagnosis-table",
        `aria-label` =
          "Disorders and diagnosis labels for the selected dataset row",

        shiny::tags$thead(
          shiny::tags$tr(
            shiny::tags$th(scope = "col", "Disorder"),
            shiny::tags$th(scope = "col", "Diagnosis")
          )
        ),

        shiny::tags$tbody(
          lapply(seq_along(disorders), function(i) {

            value <- values[i]

            state <- if (is.na(value)) {
              "unknown"
            } else if (value == 1) {
              "present"
            } else {
              "absent"
            }

            label <- switch(
              state,
              present = "Present",
              absent = "Absent",
              unknown = "Unknown (missing data)"
            )

            shiny::tags$tr(
              shiny::tags$td(disorder_labels[i]),

              shiny::tags$td(
                shiny::tags$span(
                  class = paste(
                    "diagnosis-status",
                    paste0("diagnosis-", state)
                  ),
                  label
                )
              )
            )
          })
        )
      )
    })
  }

  # Return the app without launching it automatically.
  shiny::shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
}
```

```{r}
app <- create_shiny_app(clindata, variable_key)
shiny::runApp(app)
```
